headword: {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}

definitions.explanation: A general term for not feeling well physically, often used as a reason for absence or cancellation.

examples.japanese: {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}みます→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I'm taking the day off because I'm not feeling well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠場|けつじょう}→欠場：18521_ketsujou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The athlete was absent from the match due to poor physical condition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{診|み}て→診る：09798_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Since you've been feeling unwell lately, you should get checked at a hospital.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧ (physical condition) + ⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧ (poor, defective). This is the standard polite way to explain that someone is unwell, especially in workplace and formal contexts. It is deliberately vague — it does not specify the illness, which makes it useful when the person does not want to give details.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}で⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to take time off due to illness
- {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}える→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧: to complain of feeling unwell
- {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to continue feeling unwell
- {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧: due to poor health
- {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: citing poor health as a reason

USAGE:
Very commonly seen in workplace emails, official announcements, and news reports. When a celebrity cancels an event, the reason is often announced as {体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{具合|ぐあい}が{悪|わる}い→具合が悪い：22231_guaigawarui⟧: feeling unwell — more casual, everyday expression
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧: illness, sickness — implies a specific diagnosed condition
